Heart disease is a leading cause of death in the US, impacting 1 in 3 women.

On #WearRedDay let's continue raising awareness about women's cardiovascular health. Most heart disease & stroke deaths are preventable, but we must provide funding to make treatment more accessible.

Today marks National Black HIV & Aids Awareness Day.

HIV & AIDS disproportionately impacts the Black community. We must continue working to end associated stigmas & provide the resources necessary for equal access to treatment & prevention. #NBHAAD

The #UnityAgenda from @POTUS:

✅ Beat the opioid epidemic by increase funding for prevention, treatment, harm reduction, & recovery  
✅ Take on mental health, especially among our children
✅ Support our veterans
✅ End cancer as we know it

#SOTU #BuildingABetterAmerica

It's National #LGBTQHealth Awareness Week.

Don't miss this great Wellness Fair organized and hosted by @Niagara_Pride this weekend. https://t.co/3fMoED3bh2

Did you hear?

There is a new website providing a range of COVID related information, free resources, and details about local testing and treatment options.

Visit: https://t.co/zZJgPRQ1y2

Oftentimes, insurance will cover initial treatment of a congenital condition, such as cleft palate, but follow-up treatment is denied or defined as cosmetic.

The Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act, approved by the House this week, closes that loophole.

https://t.co/RsbSACoh3v

20-30% of veterans who served in Afghanistan & Iraq returned home with PTSD. Some end up in our judicial system.

Veteran Treatment Courts, which started in Buffalo, provide access to addiction & mental health care. We are advocating for full funding in the 2023 federal budget. https://t.co/mFv03xVY2S

On average men in the US die 5 years earlier than women from complications like heart disease & cancer.

During #MensHealthMonth we encourage men to focus on their their health & wellness.

In need of a primary physician? Find a federal health center:
https://t.co/RoAxaEbXCX https://t.co/u0f7Kz5tE3

COVID-19 cases are on the rise & right now about 78% are caused by the BA.5 variant. In the event that you test positive, treatment option are available.

Check out resources from @ECDOH: https://t.co/uK1FVgPju6

The opioid epidemic has long impacted WNY. Under @bestselfwny's leadership, federal funds dedicated to this crisis are removing barriers to treatment & reaching people across the community.

Proud to join local leaders to celebrate the progress made in helping WNY families. https://t.co/dH5diTNMxE

Earlier this week with @bestselfwny we announced the success of a federal grant that is helping to connect people suffering with addiction disorder to treatment.

As we recognize #OverdoseAwarenessDay we remind WNYers that help is available.

Call the 24/7 hotline: 716-463-6222

We had the opportunity to meet with Jed Manocherin of @ACTforNIH, which advocates for biomedical research funding.

The @NIH & @theNCI support programs that can deliver medical breakthroughs in cancer treatment, but greater federal funding is needed to sustain their research. https://t.co/KqGfEcLZk3

Access to fresh, healthy food is a necessity, not a luxury.

Yet, many low-income families living in WNY still struggle with food insecurity.

A $365K grant to @GGWNY & @MassAveProject will support the Buffalo Food Justice Project, addressing local food & nutrition needs. https://t.co/PvemlwwKmt

Marking #CleanWaterAct50, we joined @MayorByronBrown with federal & state environmental agencies to break ground on the @BuffaloSewer Bird Island Treatment Facility Upgrades Project.

Building on efforts to protect fresh water, the long-term project modernizes the sewer system. https://t.co/UCyDz8dYwH

Join @WNYAlz this Thursday at @CityHonors for a roundtable discussion on the latest developments in Alzheimer’s and dementia research and treatment. 
RSVP here: https://t.co/upeVk7Giho https://t.co/qNwasEtgmv

US Army Reserve SGT Renee Wiley enlisted in 1978 & worked as an Emergency Treatment NCO, providing outpatient care. While rising to Drill Sergeant, she also served as a Sex Crimes Investigator.

Wiley earned the Army Reserve Components Achievement Medal & several others. https://t.co/WJz02EyWgn

The #InflationReductionAct is builds on progress made by the #AmericanRescuePlan to decrease the cost of healthcare for millions of Americans through enhanced #ACA tax credits.

We are not only expanding healthcare access, but also improving affordability #ForThePeople.

Thanks to the PACT Act, veterans exposed to toxins while serving overseas now have improved access to VA healthcare.

WNY vets, check out resources on VA toxic exposure screenings ⤵️

Thanks to enhanced #AffordableCareAct premium tax credits in the #InflationReductionAct, ACA healthcare coverage is more affordable than ever.

Open enrollment ends on December 15. Visit https://t.co/0S9DU477YJ & get covered today.

REMINDER: Today is the last day for families to claim the #ChildTaxCredit.

The #CTC has helped thousands of WNY families provide basic needs for their kids like food, clothing, healthcare & childcare.

If you haven't already received your credit, visit: https://t.co/kri58T7YaM

Congratulations @SpeakerPelosi on a remarkable tenure as our Democratic leader.

From healthcare, to infrastructure, gun violence prevention & much more, your ability to get things done had a transformative impact in the House & our communities.

Your accomplishments will endure. https://t.co/Te9dLtTggJ

I have heard first hand from OBGYNs in Western New York that a national abortion ban would be be detrimental to millions of Americans & our healthcare system.

We must keep fighting to protect & expand access to reproductive care.
Did you know? Thanks to the #InflationReductionAct, beginning January 1, seniors on Medicare Part D can get recommended vaccines for free!

Having affordable healthcare coverage is more important than ever, especially as we contend with the flu, RSV, & COVID heading into the winter. Open enrollment for coverage under the #AffordableCareAct is going on now & ends December 15!

Sign up today: https://t.co/9A7p8orKrZ
